summary: TurboGen Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, furnished a Form 6-K on September 24, 2026 reporting first-half 2026 results. The filing comprises unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements as of and for the six months ended June 30, 2026 (Exhibit 99.1), Management's Discussion and Analysis (Exhibit 99.2), and a press release titled 'TurboGen Reports its Financial Results for the First Half of 2026 and Advances Commercialization Preparations' (Exhibit 99.3), signed by CEO Yaron Gilboa. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are disclosed. This is a routine interim earnings report, not a special situation.
